producer.name: Hiraroku Jozo
producer.about: Hiraroku Jozo is a craft sake brewery in Shiwa, Iwate, in the grounds of the Hizume Hirai residence, a nationally designated Important Cultural Property. The Hirai family has brewed since about 1772, but the family firm was sold in 2021. The present brewery restarted in a century-old storehouse in January 2024.
